## Teams

```{=html}
<div id="team-grid" class="team-grid"><div class="loading">Loading…</div></div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const S = Sparvi, teams = await S.load("/data/nfl/teams.json");
  const divs = d3.groups(teams, t => t.division).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a[0], b[0]));
  document.getElementById("team-grid").replaceChildren(...divs.map(([div, ts]) =>
    S.el("div", { class: "team-div" }, S.el("h4", {}, div),
      S.el("ul", {}, ts.map(t => S.el("li", { html: S.nflTeamLink(t.id, t.name) }))))));
})();
</script>
```

::: {.note}
Data: [nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse) play-by-play, schedules, and team stats (CC-BY 4.0), regular seasons {{< meta nfl.first_season >}}–{{< meta nfl.season >}}. Sparvi publishes team aggregates only and isn't affiliated with the NFL or any club.
:::
